answer: Paper names wilt; only a tended plot can open a seat. A joiner locks 24 coins for 17 hours and claims one seed-chosen bay whose tagged vine is already on the public roster. At two posted clock marks at least 6 hours apart it uploads an 18-second sap-flow pulse from that tag. The second peak must sit a seed-coded delta of 0.35-0.80 ml/h from the shared bench meter. Two growers older than 15 epochs, with no shared counterparties in 39 days, confirm both traces and the tag photo. Weight unlocks only after both seals land. Reused tags or grower pairs forfeit the bond; bays are redrawn each epoch.
